scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold" "npm.cmd --prefix server run dev" "npm.cmd --prefix client run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix server run test && npm --prefix client run test
